description: Source code for a mock HTTP cache implementation used in testing Chromium's network layer, including classes for mock disk entries, disk cache, and HTTP cache, with methods for simulating cache operations and failures.

classes.name: MockDiskEntry
classes.description: Represents a mock disk cache entry used for testing, supporting read/write, sparse data, and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: MockDiskCache
classes.description: A mock implementation of disk cache for testing, managing mock disk entries and simulating cache behaviors.

classes.name: MockHttpCache
classes.description: A mock HTTP cache used for testing network layer interactions, supporting cache operations and failure simulations.

classes.name: MockBackendFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create mock disk cache backends for testing.

classes.name: MockDiskCacheNoCB
classes.description: A variant of mock disk cache that always returns errors, used for testing error handling.

classes.name: MockBackendNoCbFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create mock backends that do not invoke callbacks.

classes.name: MockBlockingBackendFactory
classes.description: A factory that can block backend creation until explicitly finished, used for testing concurrent behaviors.

methods.name: GetTestMode
methods.description: Returns the current test mode, possibly overridden by static setting.

methods.name: SetTestMode
methods.description: Sets the global test mode for the mock HTTP cache.
